description: Cycle Routes is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department for Transport. This dataset is no longer available A digital geographical description of the cycle path network, created for the Transport Direct cycle journey planner. The data described the cycle route geometry and features on cycle paths and roads. For example, cycle lanes and toucan crossings. This dataset was last updated in 2014. It is not current. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Department for Transport. The portal shows 2021-12-21 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
